_how: Item id to price in roubles, for items in Research/price-index-review.md you want set by hand. "_keep" lists items checked by hand where the rules' price stays (they leave the review list). Run price_index.py again after changing this.
_5910968f86f77425cf569c32: Weapon repair kit: set by hand (user, 2026-10-28). PvP ~108k is too cheap; at 400k it still pays off on the guns people run (a full kit saves ~884k of Prapor repairs on an M4A1, ~470k+ on an AK-74M).
_591094e086f7747caa7bb2ef: Body armor repair kit: set by hand (user, 2026-10-28). PvP ~239k is too cheap; 350k is about what a full kit saves on ordinary armour at Prapor (a Trooper repair: 15.62 points or 4,505 RUB, so 1,200 points ~346k), so it stays worth using.
_628b916469015a4e1711ed8d: AK-545 Mk.3 handguard: set by hand (user, 2026-10-29). Only 3 to 12 offers on either flea; the average (71k PvP, 200k+ PvE) is a few unsold high offers. The cheapest offers sit around 43k, and the last day's low was 50k.
